success.description: Special: The attack gains the Blast quality. You swing your tail in a wide arc across your opponents, scattering them.
You hit your target and each enemy in your engagement for -1 damage.
As above, but you hit your target and each enemy in your engagement for +1 damage instead. The targets suffer from the Staggered condition for 2 rounds.
